en.headline: Man dies after fall during police raid on Mong Kok tenement unit
en.dek: Organised Crime and Triad Bureau officers broke into a flat on Reclamation Street on Sunday night; a man believed to have tried to climb out a window was found unconscious and later died, and 21 people were taken for investigation.
body: A man died after a fall from a tenement building in Mong Kok on Sunday night during a police operation, according to multiple local media reports citing police information.

Police received a report from a passer-by around 9pm of a suspected fall outside 371-395 Reclamation Street. Officers and paramedics found a man unconscious and took him to Kwong Wah Hospital, where he later died.

Sources said officers from the Organised Crime and Triad Bureau were conducting an operation at a unit in the building at 371 Reclamation Street, an eight- to nine-storey tenement, and broke into the flat to search it. It is believed the man tried to climb out of a window to leave during the operation and fell.

Police subsequently took 21 men and women from the unit to a police station for investigation, with support from the Police Tactical Unit. The case is under investigation, and the circumstances of the fall remain under inquiry. No official police statement detailing charges has been reported.

zh.headline: 旺角新填地街警方行動期間男子疑爬窗墮樓不治 21人被帶走調查
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科人員周日晚上破門搜查新填地街唐樓單位，一名男子懷疑企圖爬窗離開時失足墮樓，送廣華醫院搶救後不治，警方帶走21人調查。
body: 周日晚上，旺角新填地街一幢唐樓發生墮樓事件，一名男子送院後不治，事件發生於警方有組織罪案及三合會調查科採取行動期間。
警方接獲途人報案，指約晚上9時於新填地街371至395號對開懷疑有人墮樓。警方及救護員到場發現一名男子昏迷，將他送往廣華醫院搶救，其後證實不治。
據了解，有組織罪案及三合會調查科人員晚上到新填地街371號一幢約八至九層高的唐樓採取行動，破門進入單位搜查。懷疑有人在行動期間企圖爬窗離開，其後失足墮樓。
警方其後在單位內帶走21名男女返警署調查，機動部隊人員亦有到場支援。案件仍在調查中，墮樓原因及經過有待進一步查明。
